summary: Betty Heimann was an Indologist and philosopher. She studied at Bonn, Kiel, and Halle-Wittenberg, and held posts at Halle-Wittenberg (~1923–1931), Kiel, Hamburg (~1931–1933), and SOAS University of London (~1934–1945).
Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya is a scholar in Buddhist studies, history, and archaeology. He has served as Dean at Lumbini Buddhist University and Chairman of the Lotus Research Centre.
Bhadriraju Krishnamurti (1928–2012) was an Indologist and linguist. He served as a Professor at Osmania University (~1962–1986) and held a post at the Institute for Advanced Study.

Bhagavan Das (1869–1958) was an Indologist and philosopher who earned an M.A. from the University of Calcutta. He served as Honorary Secretary of the Board of Trustees and Managing Committee at Central Hindu College (~1898–1916).
Bhagirath Prasad Tripathi is an Indology and linguistics scholar. He held posts at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1976 and attested in 1989 as head of the Research Department.

Bhajagovinda Ghosh works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. In 1994, he was attested as Assistant Director at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology and as an Editorial Board Member of the Bulletin of Tibetology.

Bharat Bhushan Vidyalankar studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and Agra University. A scholar of linguistics and Indology, he held posts at Kendriya Hindi Sansthan and Sandhaan (1991).

Bhikkhu Anālayo, a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar, studied under Bhikkhu Bodhi, at the University of Ceylon (PhD), and Marburg (Habilitation). He held posts at Hamburg, Dharma Drum Buddhist College, and Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy.

Bhikkhu Bodhi studied at Brooklyn College and Claremont Graduate University, and under Nyanaponika Thera and Balangoda Ananda Maitreya. A Buddhist studies scholar, he was an editor at the Buddhist Publication Society and was at Chuang Yen Monastery.

Bhikkhu Pāsādika is a scholar in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology who studied at Magadh University. He served as Professor at the University of Marburg (~1993) and held posts at the universities of Kassel and Bergen.
Bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā is a Buddhist studies scholar. She held posts at Dharma Drum Buddhist College as an Assistant Researcher (attested 2012) and at the Dharma Drum Institute of Liberal Arts.
Bhuvan Chandel is an Indologist and philosopher. She served as Professor at Panjab University (attested 2003) and as Director of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study (~2004–2007).

Bimal Krishna Matilal studied at Calcutta, Sanskrit College, and Harvard under W.V.O. Quine and Dagfinn Føllesdal. A philosopher and Indologist, he taught at Toronto and became Spalding Professor and All Souls College Fellow at Oxford in 1976.

Bindeshwari Prasad Sinha (1919–2002) completed his Ph.D. at the University of London. An Indologist and archaeologist, he served as a professor at Patna University and as Hon. Joint Director at Kashi Prasad Jayaswal Research Institute.
Bing Chen is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. He became a Professor at Sichuan University (~1987) and served as a professor at the Chengdu Academy of Social Sciences (attested 1993).
Bintao Ma is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. He earned an MA at Peking University (-2008) and a PhD at The Chinese University of Hong Kong under Xueyu (attested 2015).

Biraja Sankar Guha studied at Scottish Church College, the University of Calcutta, and Harvard. In Indology and archaeology, he held posts at Calcutta, the Zoological Survey of India (~1927–1945), and the Ethnographic Survey of India (1951).

Birgit Kellner studied under Shoryu Katsura at Hiroshima University and with Muni Jambūvijaya. She has held posts at the University of Vienna and leads the Institute for the Cultural and Intellectual History of Asia.
Bo Jiang is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who completed a PhD at Columbia University under the supervision of Robert A. F. Thurman (attested 2008).
Bo-gwang Han is a scholar of Buddhist studies who held a professorship at Dongguk University, attested in 2004 and 2015.
